title: Preferred endings and onsets meet at adjacent paragraph word boundaries
statement: In eligible paragraph text, adjacent word pairs more often join an end-preferring final unit to a start-preferring initial unit than under a within-line shuffle. The fixed tokenization and 2:1 class rule use only separate training pages. The comparison keeps the learned classes fixed, respects ineligible-word barriers, and uses 199 within-run shuffles at one-sided p at most 0.01.
source: Training-only boundary-class measurement and class rule from https://github.com/Ayan-Bandyopadhyay/voynich-swarm/pull/772 .
